description:
What this is. The last step, and what everything above feeds. One screen showing who is in today, who is absent, who is on leave and who is on their rest day — with the numbers reconciling to your headcount.

What to do. Pick a date and a farm at the top. Click any figure to see the people behind it. Lost Hours shows time lost to late starts, early finishes and absence; Actions lets you mark attendance for people the machines missed and move a group onto another shift.

Where to find it. Attendance Insights, at /attendance-insights. You need to be signed in.
